name: Camping Viktoria
beschreibung: Camping Viktoria is located in Wald im Pinzgau in the state of Tirol. The site is situated in the Kitzbüheler Alpen and is a starting point for outdoor activities. The facility offers pitches for motorhomes and tents. Modern sanitary facilities and a grocery store are available. Hikers and mountain bikers use the surrounding trails. A farm-themed playground is available for children.
